scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 24 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Krasnoe Selo → Railway Saint Petersburg - Pavlovsk
